title: LOST IN THE SHIMMERING GLOW OF DREAMS
author: Mridula Menon
text:
In her exuberance of youth
She was always fascinated by dreams
On the splendid wings of her dreams
She sailed in wonderment
Ecstatic in their allurement
Over the years
As she became more mature in her thoughts
She was amazed
to realise how very childish she had been
in her school girl crush for dreams
True dreams give zest to life
But what use are dreams
If no effort we do make
For their attainment
Life is for real
Not to squander it in the shimmering halo
Of dreams that leave us
Exhausted and dejected
Never ever allowing those dreams
To take root in our minds
For us to diligently strive
So much so they remain
Not as dreams ephemeral in nature
But in deeds
That pave the way for enriching our lives.
